name: vote_condorcet
description: Condorcet analysis of ranked ballots: the pairwise preference matrix, the Condorcet winner and loser, the Smith set, Copeland scores and the Schulze ranking with its strongest paths. Ballots may tie candidates and leave some unranked.

ballots.description: Each a ranking (list of names; an inner list is a tie) or {ranking, count}

candidates.description: Every candidate, including any no ballot ranks; default the names on the ballots

catalog.source: original; Schulze, A new monotonic, clone-independent… single-winner election method, Social Choice and Welfare 36 (2011); ideas from CIVS (github.com/andrewcmyers/civs)
